subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should the Feishu multi-bot mention fix proceed as a union_id-based rewrite, switch to another cross-app identity strategy, or wait for a broader Feishu identity design?
rationale: The submitted branch is stale and conflicting, the proposed identity source is contradicted by related issue evidence, and the decision changes message admission behavior where a wrong identity choice can suppress or misroute Feishu group messages.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving a stable Feishu bot identity source and covering every mention admission path.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this as investigation context and close or replace it only after a broader Feishu identity PR lands with positive proof.

options.title: Accept Narrow union_id Direction
options.body: Maintainers can deliberately accept the union_id fallback only with explicit proof that it populates and sibling paths are covered.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving a stable Feishu bot identity source and covering every mention admission path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and already requested changes on the exact Feishu identity decision surface.
